_comment: Release channel sources for Securesein. Only tier=primary may trigger a post; corroborating sources add score, community sources are context only. Run verify_feeds.py before wiring these up and drop anything that fails. verified=true means the URL was confirmed reachable and parseable on 2026-09-14; verified=false means the URL is a best-known candidate that must be checked.
